title: The Return
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight announces his departure from Dunder-Mifflin and begins searching for new employment while temporarily working at Staples. Meanwhile, Michael announces Oscar's return and plans a culturally themed welcome party, which causes some discomfort. Andy expresses enthusiasm about working under Jim and deals with a prank involving his missing phone, leading to his enrollment in anger management training. Michael later apologizes to Dwight and invites him to return to the company, highlighting ongoing tensions and relationships among the staff.
